title: P9 - Outcome record (ground-truth label)
description: Learning requires outcomes: reality grades the reviewer. This is the body your collector or humans POST to /intel/episodes/{id}/outcome. Labels come from YOUR ground truth (monitoring, incidents, rollbacks) - never from the agent's verdicts; the store never overwrites an existing final_label (a human's label outranks the collector). Standalone schema for wiring your outcome pipeline.

slo.description: The SLO readings observed at this horizon (free-form keys, e.g. p99_ms, error_rate).

final_label.description: Only meaningful with horizon=final; applied once, never overwritten.
